rows.evaluation_data: Chest pain can be nonspecific and described with multiple terms. The AME should review the hospital/clinic reports to identify the CAUSE of the angina or chest pain. If cause identified, see that page (e.g., musculoskeletal pain, GERD, CAD, MI, etc.). If no cause identified, go to Row B.

rows.evaluation_data_html:
Submit the following for FAA review:

1. Hospital records to include:

  • Admission history & physical (H&P)
  • Discharge summary from the physician (NOT the discharge instructions/paperwork given to the patient when leaving the hospital).

2. Coronary catheterization/ angiography report (if performed).

3. Current, detailed Clinical Progress Note(s) from any follow-up visits. It must specifically include the diagnosis and whether it was cardiac in nature or other. If cardiac, additional evaluation may be required.

4. Any other testing already performed for this condition.

If no cause is identified, additional information may be required.
